label: VIIRS active fires (S-NPP, per 0.05° cell) — trend 2018→year (Sen's slope)
units: detections per 0.05° cell per year, per yr
colormap: Red-white-green 7 bins (red = lowest / decrease, white = middle / no change, green = highest / increase)
scale: linear, symmetric about 0 (fixed across years: 98th percentile of |slope|)
source: NASA FIRMS VIIRS S-NPP 375 m standard processing (VNP14IMGTDL SP)
basis: annual total (Jan-Dec) of nominal/high-confidence VIIRS S-NPP vegetation-fire detections per 0.05° cell.
notes: Each image = per-pixel Theil-Sen (Sen's) slope of the yearly values from 2018 through the image year (>= 3 years), in detections per 0.05° cell per year, per yr. purple = decreasing, orange = increasing; white = no change. No significance test is applied per pixel: with 3-8 yearly points a slope is a description of change, not proof of a trend.
